name: Phyrexian Etali
description: The elder dinosaur Etali, turned by Phyrexia into a storm of engines and lightning, who attacks the Winged Temple.

description_citations.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
description_citations.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Etali, an elder dinosaur turned by Phyrexia, appears on the horizon with a roar and a storm.
timeline.quote: On the horizon opposite them, at the lip of the bowl in which Orazca was built, stood Etali, one of the elder dinosaurs.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun

timeline.summary: Huatli sees that nothing of Ixalan is left in Etali and flees with the company to Temilo's garrison.
timeline.quote: Etali was the storm. The Phyrexians had turned the elder dinosaur

timeline.quote: Zacama tore his head from his body, then flung it into the city below.
